info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Market Order Cancellations API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Market Order Cancellations API facilitates the efficient cancellation of market orders in the wholesale trading environment. This endpoint enables trading partners to submit cancellation requests for specific market orders identified by unique parameters. The API is typically utilized by institutional traders, broker-dealers, and financial institutions to maintain order accuracy and manage trading strategies effectively. By leveraging this API, users can ensure timely updates to their trading positions and reduce potential risks associated with outstanding orders.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a specific market order in the wholesale trading system. Ensure that you provide the correct order ID to successfully initiate the cancellation process.
